tools.name: rasayel_get_app
tools.description: Return the Rasayel app that the API key belongs to (id, name, company domain). Use it to confirm which workspace is connected. GraphQL: app.

tools.name: rasayel_list_conversations
tools.description: List conversations of the app with state, channel type, the contact and the assignee. Use pageInfo.endCursor as 'after' for the next page. GraphQL: app.conversations.

tools.name: rasayel_get_conversation
tools.description: Return one conversation by id: state, channel type, the contact, the assignee and the last message summary. GraphQL: app.conversation(id).

tools.name: rasayel_list_contacts
tools.description: List channel users (customer contacts) of the app with name, username, blocked flag and creation time. Use pageInfo.endCursor as 'after' for the next page. GraphQL: app.channelUsers.

tools.name: rasayel_list_teammates
tools.description: List the app users (teammates) with id, name, email, status and presence. Their ids are the appUserId for rasayel_send_text_message. GraphQL: app.appUsers.

tools.name: rasayel_send_text_message
tools.description: Send a text message to the customer of a conversation. The customer receives it when Rasayel accepts it. Body is Markdown. Use rasayel_get_conversation first to confirm the conversation. GraphQL: mutation textMessageCreate.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rasayel_get_conversation, rasayel_list_teammates · Private data: rasayel_get_app, rasayel_list_conversations, rasayel_get_conversation, rasayel_list_contacts · Public sink: rasayel_list_teammates, rasayel_send_text_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rasayel_get_conversation, rasayel_list_teammates · Private data: rasayel_get_app, rasayel_list_conversations, rasayel_get_conversation, rasayel_list_contacts · Public sink: rasayel_list_teammates, rasayel_send_text_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
